status: Supplementary supplier evidence and candidate cost-reduction configurations for a reproducible cost computation together with the base inputs. Not a Chief selection, procurement approval, budget-compliance verification or physical acceptance.
merge_rules: Append options and configurations to the base inputs; a duplicate option or configuration id is an error.

Base budget, currency_conversion, tax_policy, price_basis_codes, evidence_grades and excluded_gse apply unchanged; open_items, evidence_updates and rejected_or_unusable_evidence here are added to the base lists.
Resolve a configuration by copying its base configuration's resolved selection, deleting remove_roles, then applying its own selection; every selected option's role must equal its selection key.
Record the sha256 of every input file in computed outputs.
motivation: Arithmetic preview only, not a tool result: C1_baseline_traceable appears to exceed the AUD 500 ceiling in the conservative case, driven by the carbon spine upper-bound price, the sold-out DS3218 PRO servos, the receiver price and AUD 80 of unresearched allowances. The computation script must confirm or refute this from the inputs.

open_items.description: C8 depends on MG996R adequacy; run a refined gimbal load analysis with signed net rotor angular momentum under bounded yaw-differential RPM, realistic rotor inertia, pivot mass balance and thrust-line offset, then choose MG996R, SER0063 (C9) or a 6 to 7.4 V servo rail.
Bunnings prices and stock are store-dependent and Core Electronics fastener packs show 1 to 3 units per length; confirm at purchase.
8 mm pivot pins for the 688ZZ bearings and the servo linkage hardware remain allowances until CAD defines them.
Replace the assumed eight M3 packs with a CAD-derived fastener schedule.
Range and failsafe test the installed ceramic-antenna ELRS Lite receiver before any free flight.
Define barometer shielding and port placement and fusion with the MTF-01 range sensor; quantify downwash and ground-effect bias.
The Skywalker is a fixed-wing ESC; measure command-to-RPM response on the test stand and compare with a multirotor-firmware ESC if thrust or yaw response is inadequate.
The selected XT90 listing states 40 A continuous; check against reserve pack current and measure connector temperature during endurance tests.
Recompute whole-vehicle mass, energy and current budgets with the selected configuration's listed masses and CAD-derived structure masses before a provisional selection is recorded.
